scope: Offline semantic clarification of recovery choices; original logged counts and all physical outcomes retained.

definitions.explicit_selected: deduplicated nonconditional selected event; exact duplicate event tokens do not add choices
definitions.conditional_registered: conditional_fallback selected log only registers a possible fallback
definitions.fallback_activated: conditional fallback reached exclusive release evidence or continued opening after local refusal and exhausted two-call callback budget; shared set-down/early opening alone never qualifies
definitions.effective_selected: explicit selected actions union actually activated conditional fallback, deduplicated within retry cycle and branch
definitions.completed_executed: executed event plus all expected commanded physical motion steps; full release also requires measured opening, actual retreat, accepted fresh map, ready ticket and final hand-envelope clearance
definitions.unconfirmed_executed_logs: logged executed event whose complete independent physical evidence is unavailable; retained as unconfirmed, never promoted to completed execution
definitions.physical_started: distinct actual local/preload motion segment, or confirmed full-release choice with actual opening/retreat steps; partial execution is separate
definitions.following_actual_grasps: actual closure motor-phase records, including physical-only attempts whose acknowledgement is missing
definitions.rescued: following actual closure is first successful attempt of a completed integrity-valid final success; registration/planning alone never rescues
definitions.cycle_identity: episode + chronological retry ordinal + actual grasp count at failure; recovery_id retained diagnostically, never sole binding
definitions.privacy: choice reasons use online public evidence; no simulation contact or object pose used
